# A look at inclusive sertified buildings in Lutsk 

```{r}
library(leaflet)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

geo <-  read_sf("inclusive_buildings.json")


leaflet(geo) |> 
  addTiles() |> 
  setView(lng = 25.34, lat = 50.75, zoom = 14) |> 
  addGeoJSON(geo$geometry)

```
Data: https://data.gov.ua/dataset/26002586-ec16-4d48-ad02-944323025aa0
